name: Apify MCP
tagline: Run any of 5,000+ Apify scrapers from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Apify MCP server. Search the Apify marketplace, run any actor (scraper, crawler, automation), and get structured results back. The Agent Store for the public web.
longDescription:
## What it is

Apify's MCP server. Connects your agent to the entire Apify platform: search 5,000+ pre-built scrapers (Actors), run them on demand, get results as JSON, and even save them to an Apify Dataset for later.

## Why we recommend it

Apify is the marketplace of scrapers — for almost any site, someone has already built an Actor. The MCP server exposes that whole marketplace to your agent: it can find the right scraper, run it, and return the data. No need to write a custom scraper for every site.

## When to use it

- Lead generation: agent runs a LinkedIn/Google Maps actor on demand
- Market research: agent scrapes product listings from any e-commerce site
- Social listening: agent pulls recent tweets/Reddit posts matching a query
- One-off data: agent finds the right Actor, runs it, returns clean JSON
installInstructions:
1. Sign up at https://apify.com and get an API token
2. Set `APIFY_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @apify/mcp-server`

**Free tier:** $5/month in platform credits, no card required.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Apify: $5/month free platform credits. Pay-as-you-go after that.
